finding: The ch-to-s panel contains only two opaque hosts.
impact: Its sign is descriptive and cannot validate a transferable rule.

finding: Minimum support was selected after a score-blind capacity audit.
impact: The panel is prospective for endpoints, not a pristine preregistered corpus.

finding: Rare exact forms yield coarse empirical endpoint rates.
impact: Individual host reversals and zeros carry substantial uncertainty.

finding: FIELD_FIRST and FIELD_LAST depend on the frozen HPR2 parser.
impact: Physical line endpoints are reported as independent anchors.

finding: Sign-flip p-values do not model pair-selection or parser uncertainty.
impact: They are diagnostics only and do not alter the literal four-prediction decision.

finding: No f84 row occurs in the source panel.
NONE-to-q raises parser-defined field-first rate but lowers physical line-first rate.

finding: d-to-s raises field-last as well as field-first on the low-support panel.
impact: Its positive entry direction is not an exclusive entry rule.
